premises: The world-guardians are objects of worship.
The weapons of those guardians are also to be worshipped.
The worship is to be performed in this manner.
inference: Therefore, the ritual worship includes honoring the world-guardians together with their weapons in the prescribed manner.
uncertainties: The exact ritual details implied by ittham depend on the preceding context.
